observations.inspectedFrom: eBay seller front and detail photographs
observations.observed: The complete seller photograph and three close views visibly show Japanese Snorlax HSZ 027/034 with the red 16th-anniversary mark. Across the directly lit artwork and card body, the surface remains uniformly printed without a separate reflective foil layer or foil pattern, establishing the non-holo printing.

physicalObservation.basis: The complete front and close seller photographs show the directly lit card face as a uniform printed surface without a separate reflective foil layer or foil pattern. The collection owner independently identified the pictured HSZ 027/034 as non-holo.
